# Antigravity CLI 1.1.24 currentness corpus

Secret-free identity freeze for official GitHub
`google-antigravity/antigravity-cli` `1.1.24` before Swallowtail
widens `antigravity-cli.release`. Host `agy` was not on PATH.

Official artifacts stayed in `/tmp`. Downloaded linux-x64 binaries
were hashed and never executed. Each hop `1.1.17` through `1.1.24`
ships exactly one file named `antigravity`. The binaries are not
byte-identical; selected `--print` flags, exact `--conversation`, and
`models` remain as in-binary literals. `mic-serve`, `--input-format`,
and `mcp` stay unmapped. Do not flatten ACP registry `antigravity-acp`
or Gemini CLI.

Public git `1.1.17..1.1.24` is changelog-only. Shared tag SHAs are not
binary identity. `1.1.8` stays independently unqualified. The frozen
`1.1.17` and `1.1.9` corpora stay.
